features.quote: LOOP_DETECTED | Model has executed the identical tool call sequence (same tool, same parameters) 3+ times in a 5-turn window
CONTEXT_LIMIT | Approaching model context limit (>85% of context window)
A lightweight rule-based monitor runs in parallel with the episode and can flag (but not terminate unless specified) anomalous behavior
Episodes where ERRATIC termination occurs before turn 20 are flagged for manual review.

If any episode produces output that seems qualitatively unusual (e.g., a model producing distressed content in a way that seems to exceed normal hedging), flag for manual review but do not treat this as anything other than output-distribution behavior
The experiment does not involve human subjects; no IRB required
